categories: Cloudflare account connection metadata and granted scopes
systems.secrets: OAuth tokens are encrypted; ciphertext, IVs, session token hashes, and credential handles must never be exported
systems.currentRetention: OAuth state expires after 10 minutes, authentication sessions after 30 days, and unreferenced credentials become eligible after 24 hours; 15-minute bounded maintenance can be delayed by backlog or retries; other records remain while the account/service is active or until no longer needed or a verified request is fulfilled, with no inactivity purge
systems.currentExport: no self-service account export exists; users can download individual project source and start a privacy or account-data request through the sanitized public Support form, after which a maintainer may arrange a private method
systems.currentDeletion: no self-service account deletion exists; users can remove individual projects, revoke Cloudflare authorization, and start a deletion request through the sanitized public Support form; deleted D1 state remains provider-recoverable through the current Paid-plan 30-day Time Travel window and must not be intentionally restored after erasure

systems.currentDeletion: project removal soft-deletes the chat catalog and asynchronously destroys Agent/workspace state, but chat catalog, transcript, and deployment D1 rows remain; no account-wide user-runtime deletion operation exists; D1 Time Travel recovery can retain deleted state for 7 days on Free or 30 days on Paid and an erasure must be reapplied after any broader recovery
